'''Aleth-Loriel''' was a place during the time of the [[Trolloc Wars]] that is remembered in the [[legend]] “[[The Fall of Aleth-Loriel]].” [[Moiraine]] claimed its fall was as a result of the marriage of [[Rhea (wife of Caar)|Rhea]] and [[Caar al Thorin al Toren]].{{ref/book|1|19}} Its location is not known. Aleth-Loriel fell as a result of [[Mordeth]]'s evil in [[Aridhol]].{{ref/book|twotc|Aleth-Loriel}}

[[Thom Merrilin]] told the story, among many others, in the [[Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]].{{ref/book|1|17}}

==Parallels==
The name seems designed to evoke [[Similarities to Tolkien|similarities]] to {{Wlink|lotr|Lothlorien|Lothlórien}} from Tolkien's Middle-Earth.
